mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 4.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong residential sales (RSAFS > 705,000 million) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and RSAFS > 705,000, or interaction term p-value exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%), rising federal funds rates signal aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 6.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% over three consecutive months indicates weakening supply conditions, preceding negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% in 3 months) combined with high housing starts (HOUST > 1350 thousand units) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS > 0.5% and HOUST > 1350, or interaction term p-value exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 700,000 million), rising housing starts (HOUST) signal robust demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 700000 and HOUST rises, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) consistently correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days due to strong labor market conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.05.
